about: Episode 1 of EPISODES.md as a tour: My AI box waits 99% of the time. Qwen3.8 27B on the DGX Spark, the question prompt, the close-up on the GPU. Every number comes from labs/data through the mission's metrics.
title: My AI box waits {idleWrite} of the time

short.hook: My AI box waits *{idleWrite}* of the time
short.lesson: The GPU does {busyWrite} math, then waits for memory
short.next: Next: the fastest gaming GPU tries a bigger model

steps.title: Full power, for a blink
text: You hit enter, and the GPU reads your whole question at once, every block lit.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a sprinter off the blocks.

breakIt.label: paste a 30-page document
breakIt.caption: A long document keeps the GPU sprinting for seconds.

steps.caption: Reading: every GPU block lights up, for half a blink.

steps.title: Then it waits
text: Writing needs the whole model for every word, and the model lives in memory.
The GPU does each word's math in a flash, then waits for the next delivery over the bus.
Its math is busy {busyWrite} of the time.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as a sports car stuck behind a slow truck.

breakIt.label: make it 16-bit
breakIt.caption: More bytes per word, and the GPU waits even longer.

steps.caption: My AI box waits {idleWrite} of the time.

steps.title: The bus is the limit
text: The memory bus runs flat out: {busWrite} busy while the GPU idles.
{The} moves {bw}, and each word needs {perTokenGB} of it.
So the speed is set by the bus, not by the chip.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as one narrow fuel line feeding a huge engine.

breakIt.label: use an RTX 5090
breakIt.caption: A faster bus: same model, words come much faster.

steps.caption: The memory bus runs flat out. It sets the speed.

steps.title: Mission Report
text: The same question on five machines.
The ones with the fastest memory bus write fastest; the GPU waits on every one of them.
steps.metaphor: Think of it as the same engine on five different fuel lines.

breakIt.label: try the bigger Flash-Next
breakIt.caption: A bigger model: the fastest gaming card cannot load it.
